findings.summary: increment_counter performs a non-atomic read-modify-write with no locking, so concurrent invocations lose updates (50 parallel increments from 0 yielded 1) and the truncating redirect can expose an empty file to concurrent readers.
The digit regex admits leading zeros that the arithmetic context then treats as octal, so '08'/'09' raise an arithmetic error and '010' is read as 8; use 10#$1 to force base 10.
